params.body:
The Studio gets the Observatory's type scale (gentells-dashboard#67): six steps as tokens in `index.html`, nothing below 12px.

- `--text-xs` 12px
- `--text-sm` 14px
- `--text-base` 15px
- `--text-md` 17px
- `--text-lg` 20px
- `--text-xl` 24px

Until now the Studio chose its own sizes, 95 of them, down to 0.54rem (8.6px), with most text between 0.7 and 0.85rem.

All 93 hand-picked sizes in `src/` now name a token, on the same mapping as the Observatory. One display size (2.5rem) stays as it is. `body` keeps the browser's 16px, so the writing surface does not shrink.

Checked: the desk before and after at 1440px, with the API mocked. The layout holds and the text is larger. The editor was not checked; it needs a real article. Build ok.
params.title: A type scale for the Studio: the Observatory's six steps
